ns2:section.sectionText: Explores American cinema from 1950 to the present, focusing on key issues in film studies (such as authorship, genre, style, gender analysis, and the spectacle of violence), in relation to moments of major transition in the American film industry and American society. In recent semesters units have included “Hitchcock in American Culture,” “The New Hollywood,” and “Hollywood in a Global Context.” Viewing and discussion of one film each week. Analytical essays and a final exam.
